entries.title: Psalms 124:1
segments: ¶<<A Song of degrees. Of David.>> If it had not been Jehovah who was for us--oh let Israel say--

entries.title: Psalms 124:2
segments: If it had not been Jehovah who was for us, when men rose up against us,

entries.title: Psalms 124:3
segments: Then they had swallowed us up alive, when their anger was kindled against us;

entries.title: Psalms 124:4
segments: Then the waters had overwhelmed us, a torrent had gone over our soul;

entries.title: Psalms 124:5
segments: Then the proud waters had gone over our soul.

entries.title: Psalms 124:6
segments: ¶Blessed be Jehovah, who gave us not up a prey to their teeth!

entries.title: Psalms 124:7
segments: Our soul is escaped as a bird out of the snare of the fowlers: the snare is broken, and we have escaped.

entries.title: Psalms 124:8
segments: Our help is in the name of Jehovah, the maker of heavens and earth.
